mutation_policy: IMMUTABLE — no additions or renames permitted during per-cell annotation

layer_A_original_failure_layer.description: Deepest error layer causing Baseline FAIL. Assign one value per cell from the frozen Baseline evaluation artifact.

values.meaning: Python SyntaxError — code does not parse; AST cannot be built.
Code parses but violates output-schema or entrypoint contract required by the Evaluator.
Correct schema structure but domain API used incorrectly (wrong function, wrong args, missing import).
Schema correct and API correct but a runtime exception prevents completion.
Code runs but mathematical answer is wrong (semantic / reasoning error).

layer_B_healer_disposition_result.description: What the Healer did and the outcome. One value per cell per run (Primary and Post-hoc).

mapping_from_artifact_fields.ABSTAIN_NO_RULE: healer did not attempt any rule (no match)
mapping_from_artifact_fields.ABSTAIN_AMBIGUOUS: multiple competing rules; intervention not unique
mapping_from_artifact_fields.MODIFIED_UNEVALUABLE: healer transformed but evaluator could not run to completion

values.meaning: Healer ran but applied zero transformations. Code is byte-identical to input.
Healer determined no frozen rule matches this cell.
Healer matched multiple competing rules; deliberately abstains.
Healer applied a rule; post-healer Evaluator returned PASS.
Healer applied a rule; post-healer Evaluator still returned FAIL.
Healer applied a rule; post-healer Evaluator returned a new distinct failure (regression indicator).
Healer applied a rule but post-healer Evaluator could not run to completion.

layer_C_repair_signature_match.description: Whether applied repairs fall within the frozen repair signature. Cross-reference frozen_rule_allowlist in math16_ab3_freeze_manifest.json.

values.meaning: All applied rules are in frozen allowlist and change pattern is consistent with rule specification.
At least one applied rule is not in frozen allowlist, or application pattern deviates materially from spec.
Applied rules are in allowlist but analyst cannot determine from available artifacts if change pattern is fully consistent (e.g., source span not recovered).

valid_conditions.Ab2d+spec: Domain Scaffold + Standard Spec (v2 for Qwen 4B)
